events.name: run_python

args.code:
from pathlib import Path
import re

root = Path('servisler')
exclude_name = 'yedek'

ini_files = []
for p in root.rglob('*.ini'):
    if exclude_name in p.parts:
        continue
    ini_files.append(p)

ini_files.sort()

section_re = re.compile(r'^\s*\[([^\]]+)\]\s*$')
port_re = re.compile(r'^(\s*port\s*=\s*)5432(\s*;.*)?(\s*)$', re.IGNORECASE)

changed_files = []

for path in ini_files:
    data = path.read_bytes()
    has_bom = data.startswith(b'\xef\xbb\xbf')
    text = data.decode('utf-8-sig')
    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    new_lines = []
    in_veritabani = False
    changed = False
    for line in lines:
        if line.endswith('\r\n'):
            content = line[:-2]
            ending = '\r\n'
        elif line.endswith('\n'):
            content = line[:-1]
            ending = '\n'
        else:
            content = line
            ending = ''
        m_sec = section_re.match(content)
        if m_sec:
            section_name = m_sec.group(1).strip()
            in_veritabani = (section_name.lower() == 'veritabani')
            new_lines.append(line)
            continue
        if in_veritabani:
            m_port = port_re.match(content)
            if m_port:
                new_content = m_port.group(1) + '6543' + (m_port.group(2) or '') + m_port.group(3)
                new_lines.append(new_content + ending)
                changed = True
                continue
        new_lines.append(line)
    if changed:
        new_text = ''.join(new_lines)
        new_data = (b'\xef\xbb\xbf' if has_bom else b'') + new_text.encode('utf-8')
        path.write_bytes(new_data)
        changed_files.append(str(path))
        print(f'CHANGED: {path}')
    else:
        print(f'UNCHANGED: {path}')

print(f'\nToplam .ini dosya: {len(ini_files)}')
print(f'Değiştirilen dosya sayısı: {len(changed_files)}')
